summary: Verified 3 changes: (1) Telegram fully removed backend+frontend, (2) checkout country selector with pinned Monaco/Italie/États-Unis + French-alphabetical rest and dial-code prefixed to stored phone, (3) 'Remember me' save prompt on order success + autofill banner on next /checkout. Backend pytest 4/4 passing. Frontend E2E flow passes end-to-end including admin regression (settings has no Telegram) and kitchen regression.

issues: Several menu items return 404 on their /api/menu/{id}/image image URL (Mac Chicken, some signatures, some drinks). Cosmetic — falls back to 'BT' placeholder, but 404s appear in console. Pre-existing seed data issue, not related to this change set.

critical_code_review_comments: OrderSuccess.jsx: popPendingSavePrompt() is called inside useState initializer — fine (runs once), but note it consumes sessionStorage before the order data has loaded, so a fast refresh of /order/success loses the save prompt. Acceptable trade-off (product-defined 'ask at most once'), just flagging.

Checkout.jsx builds customer_phone as `${dialCode} ${form.phone.trim()}` — the space between dial-code and local number ends up stored in DB (e.g. '+377 612345678'). Consistent with admin/kitchen display seen in screenshots; if you ever consume phone programmatically (SMS, tel: links) strip spaces or store E.164 separately.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Telegram is fully gone from /api/health integrations block and both /api/telegram/{webhook,set-webhook} routes return 404. Country selector: 34 options total, first 3 pinned = MC/IT/US, then alphabetical (Allemagne, Andorre, Autriche, ...); FR sits at index 12 in the list but is the default selected value. localStorage key `bt_saved_customer` stores {first,last,phone,countryIso,email,address1,address2,postal,city}; sessionStorage bridge `bt_pending_save_prompt` is auto-consumed by OrderSuccess. Kitchen dashboard confirmed to display the +377 prefix correctly (screenshot verified). Menu image 404s (Mac Chicken etc.) are pre-existing missing-image seed data, unrelated.
